purpose: Freeze one source-backed local keyed base-support admission boundary after the Phase129 whole-ledger equality gate was shown to exceed the official and native join semantics.

decision.official_admission_model: sameSat common-satellite selection, per-frequency-field residual stream, finite in-domain interpolation, and per-observation finite corrected-code factor gate
decision.native_admission_model: exact (SatelliteId,SignalType) stream lookup at the factor epoch, finite in-domain correction, local factor drop, and side-local conservation
decision.current_phase129_failure: runner requires complete rover/base tuple equality even though each side independently conserves its own rows

source_pins.evidence: sameSat common-satellite selection followed by fixed moving mean and linear interpolation at rover times without extrapolation
per-frequency correction and per-observation finite P/D factor guards
same correction and local finite factor admission in the IMU graph
per (SatelliteId,SignalType) stream, finite samples, monotonic stream guard, and exact endpoint/in-domain interpolation
exact source key and no-extrapolation lookup contract
local missing-key/domain/nonfinite drops, one subtraction, and post-conservation swap
the miss mask is applied once to the shared pseudorange factor vector before both stage paths
native exact query-time satellite/signal annotation and row-local GLO skip

join_contract.query: existing FGO factor epoch/query time; no new time conversion or iteration
join_contract.official_join: common satellite after sameSat, then selected frequency field and rover-time interpolation
join_contract.unmatched_rover_action: explicit factor miss; omit raw rover factor

support_and_formula.smoothing: existing route-frozen centered moving mean; 1-second route => 151 samples, 15-second route => 11 samples
support_and_formula.support: exact finite endpoint sample, or two adjacent finite same-key samples bracketing the rover query time
support_and_formula.interpolation: pc_l + (t_r - t_l)/(t_u - t_l) * (pc_u - pc_l), only when t_first <= t_r <= t_last
support_and_formula.correction_application: one finite subtraction on the shared factor vector, then no second application

local_conservation.base_stream_partition: finite_certified_base_samples + rejected_or_unusable_base_rows = eligible_base_rows; unused finite samples remain accounted, not errors
local_conservation.cross_side_partition: forbidden; no equality is imposed between rover and base totals
local_conservation.retained_factor_predicate: certified rover row AND exact base key AND finite in-domain support AND finite corrected code
local_conservation.factor_support_cardinality: exactly one correction result per retained rover factor; an interior result has one left/right bracket pair
local_conservation.unused_base_stream_policy: allow a finite base key/sample with no rover query and report it as unused

exception_and_fail_closed_policy.phase127_128_provenance: header/geph missing, mismatch, conflict, tie, invalid, or out-of-time remains the existing typed provenance decision; no fixed or inferred FCN
exception_and_fail_closed_policy.duplicate_base_time: global fail-closed; no deduplication or winner selection
exception_and_fail_closed_policy.all_miss_or_empty: fail before solver when no finite usable base stream or corrected factor remains
exception_and_fail_closed_policy.partial_application: fail closed; candidate map/vector is not exposed

candidate.scope: Replace only the Phase129 pre-solver whole-rover/base-ledger equality predicate with side-local conservation plus exact-key/time/domain support checks.
candidate.solution_output: opaque structural metadata/hash only after separate authorization

required_future_telemetry: side-local eligible/certified/explicit-miss counts by key and reason
base finite stream keys and samples
base stream keys/samples unused by any rover query
exact endpoint versus interior bracket support
retained corrected factor count and per-factor exact support marker
Phase126 A/B/C and existing C7/D/CCDD/graph gates
required_tests_before_raw: unequal rover/base row counts and unequal cadence are accepted when every retained rover row has exact-key finite support
one base stream supports multiple rover query times and unused base samples are counted but do not fail
missing exact key is an explicit factor miss with no raw or zero fallback
exact endpoint and interior bracket interpolation are accepted; out-of-domain is rejected
certified and explicit-local-miss GLO rows conserve independently on rover and base
non-GLONASS rows retain existing semantics without cross-side count equality
duplicate/non-monotonic base times remain global fail-closed
GLONASS provenance duplicate/conflict/tie remains typed and cannot be hidden by join relaxation
all-miss/empty usable population fails before solver
correction is applied exactly once and late conservation failure leaves input unchanged

future_authorization_boundary.solver_start_condition: only after inventory and local-join validator pass
future_authorization_boundary.failed_route_policy: seal NO-GO; no rerun, fallback, repair, or truth evaluation
future_authorization_boundary.solution_policy: opaque hash/row metadata only; no coordinate interpretation
